description: Agent Explore, Freshness, and Changed-File Impact — borrow low-hanging product patterns from CodeGraph while preserving repo-graph's Measure-focused Next.js/Vite scope
deviation_notes: Phase 3 §A1 and §A2 wiring were intentionally deferred: scan-time FTS sync (syncNodeFts) and per-file metadata capture (recordFileMetadata) are exposed as helpers but not auto-called from handleScan / updateFiles. Tests cover the helper contracts directly (search.test.ts and files.test.ts). Until the bulk callers invoke the helpers, a freshly scanned DB can lag FTS until the caller syncs each node and may not surface freshness warnings until the caller records metadata. Captured in measure/tech-debt.md as a Medium-Open follow-up. Phase 4 confirmed all 10 acceptance criteria and coverage ≥80% on every new module.
